name: Brumal-Hamada

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs an ancient meteor crater, stark under a black sky.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on aluminum, iron, platinum and silicon are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
